summary: Measured kernel-throughput (recompute-tok/s) CDC contiguous vs PIC scattered-selective, inj/seq>=5% x batch{1,8,32}. PIC wins ONLY 2/24 cells, both MARGINAL (0.993-0.994x) at the 8k/5% corner (B=1 and B=32). CDC wins the other 22 (up to 1.74x at 8k/50%/B=8). CDC's contiguous advantage extends to THROUGHPUT, not just TTFT. Honest measured negative table for the PIC-favorable regime (VERDICT-0029 option b). NOT full vLLM serving.
